summary: Master project rescue and turnaround management to recover schedules, control costs, and deliver executive-ready recovery plans. Enrol now.
lede: Project rescue and turnaround management helps delivery professionals diagnose troubled work and restore control over cost, schedule, risk and governance. For project managers, controls specialists, PMO analysts and others overseeing delivery, the course covers variance and critical-path analysis, scope prioritization, risk and issue management, and recovery scheduling. Learners also create recovery dashboards, action plans and executive briefings to support a credible turnaround.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in project delivery, controls, governance, or sponsor oversight and need to recover troubled work with credible methods.
prerequisites: You need basic project delivery experience, a laptop, and access to spreadsheet software for the recovery exercises. A background in schedules, budgets, or project governance will help you get more from the turnaround diagnostics and reporting work.
